evaluation: original B: 529 pairs; previously inspected in earlier rounds, retrospective validation
selection: maximize corrections minus harms; tie: fewer harms, then simpler/cheaper policy, then lexical name; include unchanged baseline
candidate_sources: all saved single/window DAS conditions in das_tf_spans
fixed original DAS/mean-difference selected conditions: accept changed label only when both agree
new low-strength single/window DAS conditions specified below
no_test_feedback: fit writes selected policies using only A; evaluate selected policies on B once, do not change after B
scope: binary statement accuracy and baseline-correct harm; does not certify open-QA or full 2x2
amendment_reason: A-only primary fit selected baseline for Llama (no positive candidate within 0.5% harm); Qwen selected alpha1.5. No new B outcome evaluated.
fallback: Only when primary fit selects baseline, try original fixed E with baseline confidence lo<=max(p,1-p)<hi; grid [.5,.6,.7,.8,.9,.95,1.01]; same harm cap/objective. Otherwise retain primary.
